jobs.title: Solutions Architect
jobs.description:
Cleartelligence is a data, analytics, and AI consultancy that helps enterprise and private equity clients envision, design, and implement solutions to solve complex business challenges and accelerate value creation through data-driven insights.

As a Solutions Architect, you will be a trusted client partner and strategic advisor, leading end-to-end data engagements that deliver high-impact business outcomes. This is a technical leadership role requiring a balance of technical expertise, engagement management, and strategic vision.
You will be responsible for defining technical architecture, overseeing solution implementations, and managing cross-functional teams while ensuring client success. Your work will bridge business needs with technology solutions, helping organizations modernize their data ecosystems, enable self-service analytics, and scale data driven insights.

This role is ideal for senior data and analytics professionals who are looking to take on greater leadership responsibilities and help architect and develop strategic solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Client & Engagement Leadership
Become a key client partner, building relationships and driving strategic data and analytics initiatives.
Lead end-to-end project execution, ensuring business alignment, stakeholder engagement, and high-quality deliverables.
Bridge business and technical teams, translating complex data challenges into actionable solutions.
Solution Architecture & Data Enablement
Design scalable, cloud-based data platforms, leveraging Sigma, Snowflake
, Databricks, dbt, and modern architectures.
Experience designing & implementing AI solutions on Snowflake and/or Databricks, including AI services, semantic layers, and agents
Proficiency with data visualization tools like Tableau and Power BI
Develop and implement data enablement frameworks, empowering organizations with self-service analytics and governed data access.
Establish data governance, metadata management, and data democratization strategies to drive adoption.
Oversee the implementation of ETL/ELT pipelines, data lakes, data warehouses, and AI/ML solutions.

Technical Leadership & Team Management

Lead cross-functional teams of data engineers, analysts, and visualization experts, ensuring technical excellence and innovation.
Mentor and upskill team members, fostering a culture of collaboration, continuous learning, and thought leadership.
Ensure the use of best-in-class methodologies and technologies.

Business Development & Growth

Identify and pursue new business opportunities, contributing to sales strategies and proposal development.
Drive thought leadership, representing Cleartelligence at industry events and in client workshops.
Expand client relationships through trusted advisory and long-term engagement strategies.

What We Are Looking For

We are seeking a seasoned data leader with a passion for solution architecture, data enablement, and client engagement. The ideal candidate will have:
8+ years of experience in data strategy, analytics, and solution delivery, ideally within a consulting or enterprise setting.
Expertise in modern data platforms ( Snowflake
, Databricks, dbt), reporting and workflow platforms ( Sigma
), and cloud ecosystems (AWS, Azure, GCP).
Technical Certifications with Snowflake highly desirable.
Strong knowledge of data enablement strategies, including self-service analytics, data governance, and metadata management.
A deep understanding of data engineering, analytics, and visualization tools (Python, SQL, Tableau, Power BI).
Ability to lead teams, manage client expectations, and drive successful project outcomes.
A strong business mindset, capable of aligning technical solutions with enterprise goals.
Leadership qualities that inspire teams, clients, and stakeholders to drive meaningful change.

The anticipated annual base salary is $185K - $220K. Final pay rate will be determined based on experience, qualifications and geographic location

It is our policy to provide and promote equal employment opportunity to all employees and applicants for employment following all local, state, and federal laws and regulations governing personnel activities. Under federal guidelines we are committed to a program of affirmative action for work sites in the United States.

jobs.title: AI Solutions Developer
jobs.description:
AI Solutions Developer

San Francisco, CA
Full-time | Onsite | San Francisco Financial District

ABOUT US:

We are a premier Bay Area commercial general contracting firm specializing in building renovations, infrastructure, laboratories, and tenant improvements—with a strong focus on sustainability and LEED-certified projects. Our dedication to teamwork, collaboration, and superior quality sets us apart. We build environments where people thrive

POSITION OVERVIEW:

We are seeking an AI Solutions Developer to help identify, build, integrate, and improve practical, reusable AI tools for use across the company. This hands-on role will work closely with leaders and employees to understand business needs, translate them into useful solutions, and move quickly from idea to tested tool. The ideal candidate is an energetic builder who is comfortable creating reusable AI skills, agents, custom GPTs, and related generative AI solutions; bringing structure to ambiguous executive workflows; learning how construction teams work; and iterating based on testing and user feedback. Success in this role requires curiosity, sound judgment, clear communication, and the ability to balance speed with quality and responsible use

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Business Discovery & Prioritization

Partner with leaders and employees to understand business challenges, workflow pain points, and desired outcomes
Navigate loosely defined executive workflows and turn conversations, exceptions, and informal practices into clear use cases, tool instructions, user steps, and testable success criteria
Help assess opportunities based on usefulness, feasibility, implementation effort, and responsible-use considerations

AI Solution Development & Integration:

Prototype and develop reusable AI skills, agents, custom GPTs, and related tools that can support repeatable workflows rather than isolated one-off requests
Configure and connect approved AI tools with relevant workflows, information sources, or systems where appropriate
Test solutions rigorously for accuracy, reliability, usability, permissions, confidentiality, and business-process fit; personally review AI-generated output, document findings, and resolve material issues before release
Create easy-to-follow documentation covering purpose, instructions, setup, limitations, ownership, troubleshooting, and maintenance so others can support and improve each solution
Maintain and improve deployed solutions as business needs, available tools, and user feedback evolve

Adoption & Continuous Improvement:

Gather feedback from users, identify friction, and make focused improvements that increase usefulness and adoption
Create concise guidance and demonstrations that help employees use approved AI tools effectively
Share progress, tradeoffs, and recommendations with stakeholders in clear, practical language
Help define simple measures of value, such as time saved, process quality, user adoption, or reduced rework

Responsible AI Use:

Follow applicable requirements for data handling, access, confidentiality, human review, and approved technology use
Identify potential quality, privacy, security, or implementation risks and raise them before a tool is expanded to more users

QUALIFICATIONS:

Required Qualifications:

Demonstrated ability to design, build, test, and improve reusable AI skills, agents, custom GPTs, or comparable generative AI solutions—not only one-off tools
Ability and comfort navigating loosely defined or messy executive workflows and translating them into clear tool instructions, user steps, and practical working solutions
Strong learning agility and problem-solving skills, with a bias toward rapid prototyping and thoughtful iteration
Ability to communicate clearly with both technical and nontechnical colleagues, ask effective questions, and incorporate feedback
Strong testing discipline, including evaluating accuracy, permissions, confidentiality, and the quality of AI-generated output through hands-on human review
Ability to create clear, easy-to-follow documentation so others can use, maintain, troubleshoot, and improve what has been built
Sound judgment when working with company information, tool access, user permissions, and sensitive workflows.

Preferred Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, information systems, construction management, or a related field—or equivalent practical experience
Familiarity with commercial construction workflows, terminology, or project teams
Experience connecting AI tools to business workflows, data sources, or software systems
A portfolio, prototype, academic project, or other work sample that demonstrates handson AI solution development

KEY COMPETENCIES & ATTRIBUTES:

Nimble: Learns quickly, adapts to changing priorities, and turns feedback into useful iterations
Grateful: Approaches collaboration with humility, curiosity, and appreciation for the expertise of others
Fair: Builds and evaluates solutions thoughtfully, considers how tools affect different users, and communicates limitations honestly
Passionate to Deliver: Takes ownership of commitments and follows through with practical, high-quality results

WORK LOCATION & SCHEDULE EXPECTATIONS:

This is a full-time, onsite position based in the office in San Francisco's Financial District

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we are an organization that values diversity. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates, including minorities and persons with disabilities.

jobs.title: Clinical Data, Automation, and AI Solutions Developer
jobs.description:
Clinical Data, Automation & AI Solutions Developer (Contract)

About the Opportunity

We're partnering with a growing biotechnology company looking for a hands-on technical contractor to improve data management, reporting, and workflow automation across its clinical development organization.
This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys solving problems, building practical technical solutions, and using data and AI to make everyday work easier. The ideal candidate has strong programming skills, experience connecting systems and automating processes, and an interest in applying technology within the biotech or pharmaceutical industry.

The Opportunity

You'll work with teams across Clinical Operations, Data Management, Regulatory, and other development functions to improve how information is collected, shared, and reported.
This is a hands-on role focused on building and maintaining solutions rather than managing a team or overseeing projects. You'll develop integrations, create dashboards, automate manual processes, and build AI-powered tools that help teams work more efficiently.
The position is fully remote and offered as an initial 12-month contract, starting at approximately 20 hours per week, with the potential for increased hours as business needs evolve.

What You'll Be Doing

Build and maintain data connections between clinical systems, vendor platforms, and internal reporting tools using APIs and data integrations.
Write scripts using Python, SQL, JavaScript, PowerShell, or similar technologies to process, validate, and reconcile data.
Develop Smartsheet solutions, including Data Shuttle, automated workflows, alerts, and cross-sheet connections.
Build dashboards and reports using tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Smartsheet to improve visibility into clinical studies and operational performance.
Automate repetitive tasks using Power Automate, Power Query, scripting, and other automation tools.
Develop and improve AI agents and assistants using Microsoft Copilot Studio, M365 Copilot, or similar platforms.
Troubleshoot technical issues, improve data quality, and ensure integrations and reports run reliably.
Document solutions and provide guidance to help internal teams use and maintain the tools.

What They're Looking For

Strong hands-on programming and scripting experience, particularly with Python, SQL, JavaScript, PowerShell, or similar languages.
Experience building and troubleshooting REST API integrations and data pipelines.
Experience developing dashboards and reports, including the underlying data models.
Hands-on Smartsheet experience, particularly Data Shuttle, integrations, and workflow automation.
Experience with Power Automate and Power Query.
Experience building AI agents, assistants, or AI-powered workflows, ideally using Microsoft Copilot tools.
Ability to work independently, solve problems, and deliver working solutions.
Strong communication skills and the ability to document technical work clearly.

Experience in biotech, pharmaceuticals, clinical research, or other regulated environments is a plus. Familiarity with clinical trial systems such as EDC, CTMS, eTMF, IRT, or LIMS would also be beneficial.

Why This Opportunity Stands Out

This is a chance to make a direct impact at a growing biotech company by improving how teams manage data, access information, and complete everyday tasks.
You'll have the opportunity to work across different development functions, build practical solutions, and apply automation and AI to real business challenges.

Position details:

12-month contract with the potential to extend.
Approximately 20 hours per week initially, with the possibility of increased hours.
Fully remote, with occasional travel.
Potential for future full-time employment, depending on business needs and mutual interest; conversion is not guaranteed.

If you enjoy hands-on technical work and want to use data, automation, and AI to solve practical problems in biotech, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Drive
jobs.description:
About The Team

DoorDash Drive powers deliveries placed through merchants' own channels—including their websites, mobile apps, and phone orders—using DoorDash's logistics network. The Drive Machine Learning team builds the prediction and intelligence systems that power this business, including delivery and pickup time estimation, merchant prep-time prediction, order release optimization, logistics decision-making, and AI-powered delivery quality signals.

Drive presents a unique machine learning challenge. Every merchant has different operational workflows, preparation patterns, and customer expectations, requiring models that generalize across millions of deliveries while adapting to highly diverse merchant behavior. Our team has significant opportunities to improve prediction accuracy, optimize logistics decisions, and build AI-native experiences that directly improve merchant, consumer, and dasher outcomes.

About The Role

As a Machine Learning Engineer on the Drive team, you'll own machine learning systems end-to-end—from feature engineering and model development to experimentation, deployment, monitoring, and continuous iteration.

Your Work Will Span Several High-impact Problem Areas

Build next-generation machine learning models for delivery ETA, pickup ETA, merchant prep-time estimation, and order release prediction that improve reliability for merchants and consumers.
Develop deep learning models that leverage large-scale spatiotemporal, marketplace, and behavioral signals to improve prediction accuracy.
Apply reinforcement learning and optimization techniques to improve logistics decision-making, assignment strategies, and marketplace efficiency.
Build AI-native product experiences using large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs). For example, transform pickup photos, item verification flows, receipts, and drop-off images into structured quality signals that help verify orders, prevent delivery defects, and improve issue resolution.
Design and run rigorous online experiments, production monitoring, and model iteration to continuously improve performance.
Partner closely with software engineers, product managers, data scientists, and platform teams to bring new machine learning capabilities into production at scale.
You'll have the opportunity to work across traditional machine learning, deep learning, reinforcement learning, optimization, and multimodal AI while solving some of the most challenging logistics problems at DoorDash.

You're Excited About This Opportunity Because...

You enjoy solving large-scale machine learning problems that directly impact millions of deliveries.
You have a strong sense of ownership and enjoy taking models from research through production.
You're comfortable working in ambiguous environments where experimentation and iteration drive product decisions.
You care about both model quality and production reliability.
You're excited to work across a diverse set of ML techniques—from neural networks and optimization to multimodal AI.
You collaborate well across engineering, product, and data science teams.

We’re Excited About You Because…

5+ years of industry experience building and shipping production machine learning systems with measurable business impact (Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD).
Strong experience developing production machine learning models using modern deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch and distributed data processing technologies such as Spark and Airflow.
Experience building, deploying, monitoring, and maintaining production ML systems end-to-end.
Strong software engineering skills in Python and experience with modern ML infrastructure and tooling.
Deep expertise in at least one of the following areas:
Deep Learning
Reinforcement Learning
Optimization / Operations Research
Large Language Models (LLMs) or Vision-Language Models (VLMs)

Experience applying machine learning to estimation, ranking, prediction, optimization, or decision-making problems at production scale.
Hands-on experience with LLMs or VLMs is a strong plus.
Experience in logistics, marketplaces, or delivery platforms is helpful but not required.
Proficiency using AI-assisted development tools (e.g. Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) throughout the software development lifecycle.
You are located or are planning to relocate to San Francisco, CA, Sunnyvale, CA, or Seattle, WA.

Company Description

Autonomique is a Physical AI company building intelligent robotic systems for complex, real-world work. We are focused on solving fundamental challenges in  robot autonomy, dexterous manipulation, and reliable deployment
.
Our bimanual robotic systems are already being deployed in manufacturing environments, where they perform demanding manipulation tasks that require precision, adaptability, and robust operation.

Role Description

We are looking for experienced robotics engineers/researchers to help build the core intelligence and software systems behind our robots.

This is a  high-impact, high-ownership role
 for someone who wants to shape the technical roadmap alongside the founding team. You will architect and implement systems spanning robot learning, manipulation, perception, task planning, and control, with a clear focus on making advanced robotics work reliably outside the lab.

You will have meaningful influence over both the product and the company, supported by  significant equity participation
 that reflects the value and impact of the role.

What You’ll Do

Define the Stack: Work directly with leadership to architect the algorithms and software systems that will power our entire fleet of robots.
Deploy Robust Manipulation Algorithms: Design and implement algorithms for complex bimanual tasks (pick/place, insertion, tool use) that don't just work in the lab but perform reliably in dynamic industrial environments.
Develop learning-based robot behaviors using approaches such as Diffusion Policy, imitation learning, and reinforcement learning to improve performance, robustness, and recovery.
Contribute to end-to-end robot autonomy systems that connect perception, semantic task understanding, and low-level robot control.
Production-Grade Engineering: Write, review, and maintain mission-critical code for our core robotics stack, establishing the engineering standards for the entire company.
Optimize & Scale: Continuously profile robotic software to maximize throughput and reliability across our growing fleet of deployed robots.

Qualifications

Education: PhD or MS in Robotics, CS, or related field with significant industry experience.
Experience: 3+ years of hands-on experience shipping code for physical robots (not just simulation).
Technical Expertise: Deep expertise in manipulation planning, imitation learning, and reinforcement learning.
Engineering Excellence: Production-level proficiency in Python and C++ with a track record of building robust, maintainable systems.

Why Join Us

Ownership: We offer a substantial equity package designed for those who believe in our mission and want to be rewarded for the company's long-term success.
Impact: Work directly on real-world projects and see your code deployed in the real world immediately.
Culture: A collaborative, high-velocity supportive environment conducive to both personal and professional growth.

Generous medical, retirement, vacations, and WfH with supportive culture.

jobs.description:
Software Engineer - Distributed Systems & Agentic AI Infrastructure

The Opportunity

We're partnering with a startup being incubated inside a top-tier venture firm.
They're not building another AI wrapper. They're building the hard infrastructure underneath agentic AI. The runtime that agents actually execute on.

The founding team is small, the technical direction is still being shaped, and the engineers who join now will define the architecture.

What You'd Be Building

Reliable agent orchestration -
fault-tolerant scheduling and execution of multi-step, multi-agent workflows at production scale
Stateful multi-agent coordination -
consensus, conflict resolution, and shared state across autonomous agents operating in parallel
Low-latency tool execution -
sub-second invocation layers that let agents interact with external systems without becoming the bottleneck
Durable memory at scale -
persistent, queryable memory backends that give agents long-horizon context without blowing up latency or cost

What We're Looking For

Deep distributed systems experience -
you've built, operated, or scaled systems at growing companies working with vast volumes of data.
Production-grade engineering -
replication, consistency, failure recovery, and state management aren't abstract concepts to you - you've shipped them
Interest in the agentic AI stack -
you don't need to be an ML researcher, but you see the infrastructure gaps in how LLM-powered agents are built today
Early-stage appetite -
you want to be in the room when the architecture is still on a whiteboard, with the backing of a world-class VC behind you
Nice to have:
Experience at the intersection of databases/storage systems and AI infrastructure (vector stores, retrieval systems, context management at scale).

Why This Role

The "agentic AI" wave is real, but the infrastructure is immature. Most agent frameworks today are single-threaded, stateless, and fragile. This company believes the unlock is at the systems layer - and they're hiring the distributed systems engineers who can build it. jobs.title: Lead HPC & AI Infrastructure Architect
jobs.description:
ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.

Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.

THE ROLE

We are seeking a Lead HPC & AI Infrastructure Architect to own the architecture and technical direction of large-scale CPU and GPU platforms across on-premises infrastructure, public cloud, and specialized GPU cloud providers. You will translate scientific computing, engineering, and AI requirements into secure, reliable, and cost-effective platforms for tightly coupled HPC workloads, distributed model training, and inference services.

This hands-on leadership role spans design, workload validation, deployment, and lifecycle management. You will guide infrastructure engineering and SRE teams and partner with researchers, AI engineers, cloud providers, and hardware vendors to deliver production-ready platforms.

THE PERSON

You combine deep systems expertise with practical architectural judgment. You take ownership of complex technical problems, validate decisions with measurable results, and communicate tradeoffs clearly. You collaborate across engineering, operations, security, and research teams; mentor engineers; and balance performance, reliability, security, delivery timelines, and cost. You can independently guide initiatives from requirements through production acceptance.

Key Responsibilities

Own the HPC and AI infrastructure roadmap, reference architectures, and standards for CPU/GPU clusters. Define workload placement across bare metal, virtual machines, Slurm, and Kubernetes.
Lead designs covering CPU/NUMA and GPU topology, accelerator interconnects, networking, storage, and identity. Establish validated hardware, firmware, driver, and runtime baselines.
Architect RDMA-capable fabrics and storage tiers. Validate collective communication, parallel I/O, dataset delivery, and checkpoint performance at target scale.
Design resource sharing through Slurm accounting, fair-share, quotas, QoS, preemption, and tenant isolation. Enable reproducible environments, self-service onboarding, and inference capacity planning.
Standardize provisioning, configuration, and fleet upgrades through infrastructure as code, automation, and CI/CD; manage images, containers, and configuration drift.
Define production acceptance criteria, service-level objectives, and fleet observability. Partner with SRE on fault isolation, job recovery, checkpoint/restart, incident analysis, and capacity planning.
Benchmark HPC and distributed AI workloads; improve scaling efficiency, throughput, inference latency, GPU utilization, and cost efficiency through bottleneck analysis.
Embed federated identity, least-privilege access, tenant and network isolation, secrets management, controlled container privileges, audit logging, and vulnerability management.
Lead architecture reviews, proofs of concept, provider evaluations, and technical escalations. Document tradeoffs, mentor engineers, and align delivery with stakeholders and infrastructure partners.

Preferred Experience

Typically 10+ years in infrastructure, cloud engineering, or distributed systems, including 5+ years designing and delivering production HPC or GPU platforms; equivalent demonstrated experience is welcome.
Ownership of large-scale cluster deployments involving hundreds of nodes or comparable complexity, with measurable improvements in workload performance, reliability, or cost.
Deep expertise in a major cloud platform such as Azure, OCI, or AWS, with experience integrating cloud and on-premises systems. Familiarity with specialized GPU providers such as Crusoe or TensorWave.
Strong Linux troubleshooting skills across CPU/NUMA topology, PCIe, GPU connectivity, drivers, virtualization, containers, and distributed runtime environments.
Hands-on Slurm scheduling and resource governance, plus Kubernetes experience. Understanding of MPI, distributed training, collective communication, and AI inference infrastructure.
AMD Instinct GPUs, ROCm, RCCL, and multi-node PyTorch workloads, including compatibility validation and performance troubleshooting.
HPC networking and storage, including RDMA, RoCE or InfiniBand, topology and oversubscription tradeoffs, parallel I/O, data placement, checkpointing, and enterprise connectivity.
Parallel and shared storage technologies such as Lustre, IBM Storage Scale, BeeGFS, NFS, or VAST, and object storage; network, storage, and collective benchmarks for cluster acceptance.
Terraform or equivalent infrastructure as code, Ansible or comparable configuration management, Python or Bash, and Git-based CI/CD. Familiarity with Azure CycleCloud or AWS ParallelCluster.
Observability and SRE practices using tools such as Prometheus and Grafana, including secure access, resource controls, fault recovery, and production readiness.
Experience establishing observability and SRE practices using tools such as Prometheus and Grafana, and designing security boundaries and resource controls for shared infrastructure.
Ability to lead cross-functional technical work independently, communicate architecture tradeoffs clearly, and guide projects from requirements through production acceptance.
Coordination with hardware and data center teams on rack power, liquid cooling, facility capacity, and other constraints affecting GPU platform design.

Preferred Qualifications

Hands-on experience with AMD Instinct GPUs, ROCm, RCCL, and multi-node PyTorch workloads, including compatibility validation and performance troubleshooting.
Experience with Azure, OCI, Crusoe, or TensorWave GPU environments, and cluster provisioning frameworks such as Azure CycleCloud or AWS ParallelCluster.
Experience with Lustre, IBM Storage Scale, BeeGFS, or VAST, plus network, storage, and collective communication benchmarks used for cluster acceptance.
Experience with LLM serving platforms such as vLLM or SGLang, model parallelism, inference capacity planning, and usage accounting or cost allocation.
Understanding of rack power, liquid cooling, and facility capacity constraints, with experience coordinating platform requirements with hardware and data center teams.

ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

jobs.description:
About The Team

DoorDash Drive powers deliveries placed through merchants' own channels—including their websites, mobile apps, and phone orders—using DoorDash's logistics network. The Drive Machine Learning team builds the prediction and intelligence systems that power this business, including delivery and pickup time estimation, merchant prep-time prediction, order release optimization, logistics decision-making, and AI-powered delivery quality signals.

Drive presents a unique machine learning challenge. Every merchant has different operational workflows, preparation patterns, and customer expectations, requiring models that generalize across millions of deliveries while adapting to highly diverse merchant behavior. Our team has significant opportunities to improve prediction accuracy, optimize logistics decisions, and build AI-native experiences that directly improve merchant, consumer, and dasher outcomes.

About The Role

As a Machine Learning Engineer on the Drive team, you'll own machine learning systems end-to-end—from feature engineering and model development to experimentation, deployment, monitoring, and continuous iteration.

Your Work Will Span Several High-impact Problem Areas

Build next-generation machine learning models for delivery ETA, pickup ETA, merchant prep-time estimation, and order release prediction that improve reliability for merchants and consumers.
Develop deep learning models that leverage large-scale spatiotemporal, marketplace, and behavioral signals to improve prediction accuracy.
Apply reinforcement learning and optimization techniques to improve logistics decision-making, assignment strategies, and marketplace efficiency.
Build AI-native product experiences using large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs). For example, transform pickup photos, item verification flows, receipts, and drop-off images into structured quality signals that help verify orders, prevent delivery defects, and improve issue resolution.
Design and run rigorous online experiments, production monitoring, and model iteration to continuously improve performance.
Partner closely with software engineers, product managers, data scientists, and platform teams to bring new machine learning capabilities into production at scale.
You'll have the opportunity to work across traditional machine learning, deep learning, reinforcement learning, optimization, and multimodal AI while solving some of the most challenging logistics problems at DoorDash.

You're Excited About This Opportunity Because...

You enjoy solving large-scale machine learning problems that directly impact millions of deliveries.
You have a strong sense of ownership and enjoy taking models from research through production.
You're comfortable working in ambiguous environments where experimentation and iteration drive product decisions.
You care about both model quality and production reliability.
You're excited to work across a diverse set of ML techniques—from neural networks and optimization to multimodal AI.
You collaborate well across engineering, product, and data science teams.

We’re Excited About You Because…

5+ years of industry experience building and shipping production machine learning systems with measurable business impact (Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD).
Strong experience developing production machine learning models using modern deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch and distributed data processing technologies such as Spark and Airflow.
Experience building, deploying, monitoring, and maintaining production ML systems end-to-end.
Strong software engineering skills in Python and experience with modern ML infrastructure and tooling.
Deep expertise in at least one of the following areas:
Deep Learning
Reinforcement Learning

Large Language Models (LLMs) or Vision-Language Models (VLMs)

Experience applying machine learning to estimation, ranking, prediction, optimization, or decision-making problems at production scale.
Hands-on experience with LLMs or VLMs is a strong plus.
Experience in logistics, marketplaces, or delivery platforms is helpful but not required.
Proficiency using AI-assisted development tools (e.g. Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) throughout the software development lifecycle.
You are located or are planning to relocate to San Francisco, CA, Sunnyvale, CA, or Seattle, WA.

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, New Verticals Agentic Foundations
jobs.description:
About The Team

Agentic Foundations, part of New Verticals ML, builds the core AI/ML intelligence that powers high-quality, scalable agents at DoorDash, and proves it through flagship agent experiences such as the Ask grocery assistant. We operate as a closed loop: new models, evals, and representations make our agents better, and real-world agent usage surfaces the gaps that drive our next foundations work.

About The Role

We’re looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to join Agentic Foundations with a primary focus on Vertical Agent Development. You will own the continuous improvement of our flagship agents, starting with the Ask Assistant, using an eval-driven loop to make them faster, more cost-efficient, and more reliable for millions of customers. You will also help us bring this approach to new agentic experiences for Merchants and Dashers, turning promising ideas into production-ready agents.

This is a chance to work at the intersection of LLMs, agents, post-training, and evals on problems that ship. You will partner closely with engineers working on agentic memory, agent-compatible product representations, and post-training of small language models (SLMs), so that what we learn from production agents feeds directly back into our foundations, and what we build there makes our agents better.

You will report into the engineering lead on our New Verticals AI/ML team. We expect this role to be hybrid with some time in-office and some time remote.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

Raise the quality of our Consumer agents: build and refine our eval harness-optimization loop to pinpoint failure modes, then iterate on prompts, tools, skills, and context, and measure the impact on real customer tasks.
Find the best balance of quality, latency, and cost: run rigorous experiments, including fine-tuning open-weights models and deploying small language models (SLMs) where they can replace or augment larger LLMs.

jobs.title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer, Fulfillment Planning
jobs.description:
About The Team

The Fulfillment Planning team builds the intelligence that powers DoorDash’s logistics network. We optimize how deliveries are planned and executed across the full delivery lifecycle, improving customer experience, merchant outcomes, Dasher efficiency, and DoorDash profitability. Our mission is to improve fulfillment quality while reducing fulfillment cost. We do this by applying machine learning, optimization, and systems engineering to the core decisions behind assignment, routing, batching, timing, and fulfillment estimation.

The team works on some of DoorDash’s most important logistics systems, including:

The core assignment engine that matches deliveries with Dashers in real time.
Real-time ETA and fulfillment estimation systems for consumers, Dashers, and merchants across diverse geographies and all business lines.
Assignment and planning algorithms for specialized delivery types, including grocery, retail, parcel, and catering.
ML models and optimization algorithms that shape demand, improve service quality, and reduce cost.
Tier-0 logistics services that require high reliability, low latency, and strong operational discipline.

The team also builds reusable ML systems and modeling patterns that scale across DoorDash’s logistics ecosystem. This role will help define the technical direction and best practices for logistics ML at DoorDash.

About The Role

We’re looking for a Staff Machine Learning Engineer
to lead the design, development, and deployment of large-scale production ML systems
that drive real-time decisioning across DoorDash’s fulfillment ecosystem.

You will start by owning ML systems for assignment and fulfillment estimation, partnering closely with Product, Data Science, Engineering, and Platform teams to improve delivery quality, cost, and efficiency. Over time, you may also contribute to adjacent areas such as batching, fulfillment execution, demand shaping, and logistics optimization across DoorDash’s business lines.

This is a high-impact individual contributor role for someone who enjoys building 0→1 ML systems, operating at Staff-level scope, and influencing technical direction across multiple teams. You will define architectures, set modeling and deployment standards, mentor other engineers, and help shape how DoorDash applies machine learning to logistics at scale.

Own and build foundational ML systems that directly impact delivery quality, cost, and overall logistics efficiency across DoorDash.

Lead 0→1 ML initiatives, defining how machine learning and optimization are applied across fulfillment products.
Influence architecture, strategy, and execution for a Tier-0 service critical to DoorDash’s logistics platform.
Collaborate closely with Product, Data Science, and Platform Engineering in a highly cross-functional environment.
Establish best practices for model development, deployment, monitoring, retraining, and governance.
Define and lead DoorDash’s cutting-edge AI vision for logistics: an LLM-inspired foundation model for intelligence across logistics
Mentor other engineers and raise the technical bar for logistics ML across the organization.

We’re Excited About You Because…

You have 8+ years of industry experience building and deploying production-scale machine learning systems.
You have strong machine learning fundamentals and know how to apply them to large-scale production systems.

You have designed, launched, and operated mission-critical ML models or systems in production, including monitoring, retraining, reliability, and governance.
You can lead complex technical projects end to end and influence stakeholders across multiple teams or organizations.
You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical audiences.
You are comfortable operating in ambiguous problem spaces and turning 0→1 ideas into production systems.
You have built or shipped large-scale ML models for recommendation, ads, marketplace, logistics, or other domains.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Machine Learning
jobs.description:
About The Team

DoorDash is building the world's most reliable on-demand, logistics engine for delivery. We are continuing to grow rapidly and expanding our Engineering offices globally! We are looking for Software Engineers, Machine Learning to build and maintain a large scale 24x7 global infrastructure system that powers DoorDash's 3-sided marketplace of Consumers, Merchants and Dashers.

About The Role

As a Software Engineer, Machine Learning, you’ll be conceptualizing, designing, implementing, and validating algorithmic improvements to the catalog system and our product knowledge graph at the heart of our fast-growing grocery and retail delivery business. jobs.title: Staff Software Development Engineer: GPU, AI/ML Ops & Quality Engineering
jobs.description:
ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.

Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.

The Role

We are looking for a talented engineer to join our team: developing heterogeneous software for computer vision, image/video processing as part of the AMD Radeon Open Ecosystem (ROCm). The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment and brings strong communication, problem-solving, and prioritization skills to the table. We value individuals who are critical thinkers, detail oriented and passionate about building high-performance software. We need a candidate who has deep domain expertise in computer vision as well as strong in quality engineering and integration testing with fast paced ROCm releases.

The Person

You are accustomed to working in a dynamic, geographically distributed agile team, where partnership and collaboration are paramount. You possess excellent written and verbal communication skills, strong attention to detail, and the ability to express your work in a clear, cohesive fashion. Most importantly, you are constantly thinking of ways to make world-class software with reliability and performance.

Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and optimize GPU/CPU software for computer vision, image and video processing workloads.
Validate new SW features before releasing them to customers. 
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver robust software extracting best performance from AMD hardware
Debug and resolve complex software issues across multiple layers of the stack.
Apply software engineering methodologies and AI tools to ensure robust, maintainable code
Develop technical relationships with peers and partners
Work very closely with dev teams and Project Managers to drive results
Strong experience with GoogleTest (gtest) for unit and integration testing in C++.
Hands-on experience with Jenkins or GitHub Actions for automating test execution and integrating tests into CI/CD pipelines.
In-depth knowledge of software testing methodologies, frameworks, and tools for automated testing.

jobs.title: Oath Technologies - Formal Methods Research Engineer
jobs.description:
About Oath Technologies

Oath Technologies is a new research organization building tools for oversight of advanced AIs. As AIs become more powerful, it will become more difficult to understand and monitor their behavior. Oath is building oversight tools based on formal verification: rather than monitor AIs directly, humans define unambiguous rules, and AIs must provide trustworthy mathematical evidence of compliance. In this way, Oath will help keep humans safe and in control as AI advances.

Oath is a Focused Research Organization (FRO) incubated and fiscally sponsored by Convergent Research. Convergent has incubated 12 FROs spanning mathematics, astrophysics, neuroscience, climate, biology, and AI, including the Lean FRO (formal mathematics and verification) and E11 Bio (whole-brain circuit mapping). Oath is led by CEO Dr. Mike Dodds, and is based in Berkeley, CA.

Role Summary

Oath's research engineers will build novel formal methods tools and apply them at scale to AI oversight problems. To do this, we are hiring both formal methods specialists and engineers with skills such as developer tools, scalable testing, agent development, AI/ML, and others that complement Oath's mission. Engineers may have skills in one or several areas, and our team will be tightly integrated, with both categories working together.

Oath will target very difficult verification and oversight problems, far beyond previous formal verification projects in scale and complexity. Oath's research team will work iteratively, building tools, testing them on our flagship problems, identifying failures, and then feeding those back into our tool designs.

We plan to build an Oath team of around six people by the end of year one, growing to a steady state of around twelve people by year three. Oath's roadmap runs for five years, and we’ll set more ambitious targets as the outcomes of our work and changes in the profile of AI risk evolve. This is a strong fit for people who want to tackle complex, high-stakes challenges in a nimble, collaborative organization.

Oath's current plan is to build tools across three families: **design** (authoring new specifications), **lifting** (extracting specifications from existing systems that have none), and **audit** (stress-testing specifications for gaps or adversarial manipulation). We're applying these to a first flagship target, verified agent containment: proving that an AI agent can't escape the permissions and sandboxing meant to bound it, from the OCI container runtime down to Linux kernel isolation primitives. Most of this work will be done in Lean or adjacent formal-verification infrastructure, with AI agents doing much of the day-to-day drafting and proving under close review.

Primary Responsibilities

Contribute directly to Oath's research goals: building tools, applying them to real systems, and iterating based on what works.
Help scale Oath's tools to large, long-running experiments intended to map the frontiers of AI oversight capabilities.

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Growth
jobs.description:
Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.

The Growth Machine Learning Engineering team partners closely with Data Science to take models from experimentation into reliable production. We own the underlying ML data infrastructure: standardizing shared feature definitions, eliminating data leakage in training pipelines, automating scheduled retraining, and establishing safeguards so faulty batch scoring runs never affect live promotions. By managing data integrity, deployment pipelines, and production monitoring, we provide the dedicated engineering support needed to keep model-driven growth initiatives dependable and scalable.

You Will

Own the feature layer between the Growth DB and the models. Work with data engineering on schema design for ML features, and with data science to turn their feature lists into versioned feature definitions that training and scoring both read from.
Build point-in-time correct training data, so a retrain sees each day as it was and does not leak future data. Data science has already named this as a gap in today's pipelines.
Take models data science has trained and put them into production: validate against the offline results, wire them into batch scoring, and add input and output checks that stop a bad run before promos go out.
Lead training automation: scheduled retrains, a model registry, and validation before a new model version is promoted.
Monitor models in production: feature drift, score distribution shifts, and model versus random arm results.
Be data science's day-to-day engineering counterpart, so feature and modeling questions do not queue behind the tech lead.

You Have

Experience at roughly building production ML systems: feature pipelines, training data generation, batch inference.
Strong SQL and Python, plus large-scale data processing (Flume, Beam, Spark or similar).
Designed feature schemas or worked on a feature store, and understands point-in-time correctness and train/serve skew from having fixed them.
Productionized and owned the lifecycle of an existing offline model
Worked with data scientists and can turn a loose feature request into a spec.

We Prefer

Background in uplift modeling, causal inference or experimentation (A/B tests, holdouts), enough to understand what the models need.
Experience in ads, marketing, recommendations, pricing or promotions.
Familiarity with feature stores, workflow orchestration (Airflow or similar) and distributed SQL databases.

The expected base salary range for this full-time position across US locations is listed below. Actual starting pay will be based on job-related factors, including exact work location, experience, relevant training and education, and skill level. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for the role location or, if the role can be performed remote, the specific salary range for your preferred location, during the hiring process.

Waymo employees are also eligible to participate in Waymo’s discretionary annual bonus program, equity incentive plan, and generous Company benefits program, subject to eligibility requirements.

Salary Range

$175,000—$215,000 USD

Join our team building 3D reconstruction and generative AI for sensor simulation. You'll turn real-world sensor data into high-quality static and dynamic 3D scenes that help close the sim-to-real gap. Your work directly shapes how next-generation AI systems are trained and validated.

Develop 3D reconstruction and neural rendering methods, including 3D Gaussian Splatting, for large-scale, dynamic driving scenes.

Strong Python and PyTorch skills.

Experience with LiDAR and other sensor data, and with multi-sensor calibration.
C++ and CUDA.
Strong linear algebra and optimization skills.

Data Scientist – Analytics, Automation & Machine Learning

St. Louis, MO

Hybrid On-site

Compensation: $55 - $67 per hour (starting at; final offer may vary based on experience, skills, and internal equity)

About The Role

Our Fortune 100 telecommunications client is seeking a dynamic Data Scientist specializing in analytics, automation, and machine learning to support Customer Operations and cross-functional product squads, including Device, Billing, UCM, Chat, Repair, and Mobile. As an embedded analytics partner, you will work closely with operations teams, product owners, and senior leadership to develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and Python-based automations using tools such as Python, Tableau, Splunk, and SQL. This hybrid on-site role in St. Louis focuses on translating complex business challenges into actionable data solutions, building and optimizing data pipelines, and contributing to advanced analytics and machine learning projects. You will play a key role in data mapping, dashboard and report creation, automation of executive reporting, migration of legacy workflows, and support for predictive modeling and natural language processing initiatives. The ideal candidate is a self-starter who can independently turn ambiguous business questions into practical data solutions and clearly communicate technical findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including directors and VPs.

What You'll Do

Understand and map data from Splunk, SQL Server, Oracle (OAR), Snowflake, and Google Cloud Storage to business processes across Customer Operations.
Write Python and SQL code to extract, transform, and load data from multiple enterprise systems into reliable, production-ready pipelines.
Develop, maintain, and optimize Tableau dashboards and Splunk reports used by operations teams and senior leadership, ensuring quality across a large portfolio of analytics assets.
Translate complex or ambiguous business questions into clearly scoped analytics problems, design solutions, and deliver actionable findings that support business decisions.
Develop data validations, anomaly detection, and quality checks to ensure data populations and production pipelines remain complete and accurate.
Automate recurring executive reporting and weekly status updates using Python, Jira REST APIs, Prefect, Windows Task Scheduler, and related tools.
Support migration of legacy Alteryx workflows and PowerShell scripts to Python-based Prefect flows running in Docker containers.
Contribute to predictive modeling and machine learning use cases such as agent fraud detection, Next Best Offer (NBO) targeting, operational forecasting, call listening, and reducing manual work.
Apply statistical and machine learning techniques, including classification, regression, clustering, tree-based models, and time-series analysis, to identify trends, seasonal patterns, and anomalies in operational data.
Support natural language processing initiatives such as sentiment analysis, intent classification, topic modeling, and embedding-based semantic search across large volumes of agent interactions.
Help deploy and maintain analytical models through GitLab CI/CD and Prefect; monitor model performance, identify drift, and refine solutions based on production feedback.
Build lightweight internal applications and branded HTML reports using Streamlit and Python to make insights accessible to operations teams.
Refresh and improve existing analytics in response to stakeholder feedback, evolving business needs, and measurable operational outcomes.
Identify data quality risks, model drift, and pipeline failures, escalating issues to the Lead Data Scientist and executive sponsor as appropriate.
Participate in Agile ceremonies as an embedded analytics partner; create Jira tickets with clear acceptance criteria, business rationale, and timelines, and own assigned work through completion.
Communicate analytical findings, model insights, and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, including product owners, operations teams, and senior leaders.
Proactively clarify requirements, take ownership of end-to-end delivery, and support special projects and other duties as needed.

What You Bring

Hands-on experience using Python, Tableau, Splunk, and SQL to build dashboards, reports, data workflows, and automations.
Strong SQL skills and the ability to query, interpret, and work with data from multiple enterprise systems (e.g., Snowflake, Oracle, SQL Server, Google Cloud Storage).
Experience translating business needs into analytical solutions and independently delivering work from discovery through implementation.
Strong communication and presentation skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts and findings to non-technical stakeholders and senior leadership.
Analytical problem-solving skills and an understanding of data quality, validation, and reliable production reporting.
Ability to manage assigned work, document requirements clearly, participate in Agile delivery, and collaborate with product and operations teams.
Experience with machine learning, predictive modeling, or AI-enabled analytics (preferred).
Exposure to natural language processing, sentiment analysis, intent classification, topic modeling, semantic search, or analysis of conversational data (preferred).
Experience with MLOps, model deployment and monitoring, GitLab CI/CD, Prefect, Docker, or production machine learning workflows (preferred).
Familiarity with Streamlit, Jira REST APIs, and migration of Alteryx workflows or PowerShell automation to Python-based workflows (preferred).
Familiarity with AI and analytics tools such as Kira or Claude Cowork is a plus, but not required.

What's In It For You

401(k) Matching Plan
Medical, Dental, & Vision Plans
Relationship-driven process to find your best fit
6 Paid Holidays
Regular meetings to ensure quality in your engagement
Competitive medical, dental, vision, Health Savings Account, Dependent Care FSA, and supplemental coverage options
Paid time off, sick time, and paid company holidays
Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with virtual counseling, financial services, legal services, and life coaching

How To Apply

Please submit your resume through the official application channel. A brief summary of relevant experience with Python, Tableau, Splunk, SQL, automation, and stakeholder communication is encouraged.

jobs.description:
About Us

Health is the most important thing in life, and the American healthcare system is completely broken - poor outcomes, high cost, bad patient experience. We're building a new system from the ground up.

Our mission is to improve people’s health by making it easy to live a healthy lifestyle.

Nourish is the country's largest dietitian-led metabolic health clinic. We’re an AI-native digital health system matching patients with 10,000+ Registered Dietitians, physicians, medications, lab testing, and AI agents to deliver insurance-covered care across all 50 states. Founded four years ago, we've completed millions of appointments, tripled year-over-year, and partnered with health plans covering 200M+ Americans across 250+ health systems.

In 2026 we raised a $100M Series C, bringing total funding to $215M. The round was led by Menlo Ventures, with participation from Thrive Capital, Index Ventures, J.P. Morgan Growth Equity Partners, Maverick Ventures, Y Combinator, BoxGroup, Atomico, Daybreak, and Operator Partners.

Learn more about our Series C here: Nourish Blog, Bloomberg, Fierce Healthcare, Digital Native, The Pulse Podcast.

This is not a job for everyone.
We hold an extremely high bar because we believe talent density is our biggest competitive advantage. We're looking for people who actively choose hard, ambiguous problems, who run toward unglamorous work, give and receive candid feedback, and bring relentless resilience without the ego. Our work is important, but we are not self-important. We do this because we’re solving one of the hardest problems in the world, and the problem matters. If that's you, we disproportionately reward it.

About The Role

We're scaling quickly, and data is one of our most important strategic levers for unlocking growth and improving patient outcomes. As a Staff Data Scientist, you'll embed with our Product team and own analytics for a specific, business-critical function—developing a deep understanding of our patients and their needs and turning that understanding into business opportunities.

This role blends product analytics, experimentation, and predictive modeling in a marketplace setting: you'll build and validate production-ready models, cuse causal inference to isolate the impact of features and feature adoption, and produce deep dives that end in clear recommendations with sized business opportunities. You'll also contribute to the development of our experimentation platform, and collaborate closely across our Product, Engineering, Design & Growth teams.

Our data team is based in NYC and goes into the office 2-3 days a week. While we don't require a specific number of days in office, we're looking for people who would be excited to join us onsite.

Key Responsibilities

Own data and analytics end-to-end: Define the metrics and surface the insights that shape our understanding of our business and inform the product roadmap
Develop production-ready predictive models: Build, validate, and maintain models of churn, resurrection, and targeting
Deliver high-impact analyses: Break down complex topics into clear narratives and recommendations with sized business opportunities
Drive scientific decision-making: Design and analyze experiments, and where experiments aren't feasible, apply causal inference methods to measure the impact of features and feature adoption
Be a thought partner to Product: Work backwards from sizing a problem to proposing what we should do about it, and shape team priorities and roadmaps
Contribute to our experimentation platform: Help build the methodology, standards, and tooling that teams across the company rely on

We'd Love to Hear From You If You...

Have 6+ years of relevant experience: You've owned data science or product analytics for a product area, ideally at a consumer tech company or a marketplace
Are an experimentation and causal inference expert: You've designed and analyzed experiments end-to-end, and applied causal inference methods where experiments weren't feasible
Bring strong technical skills: You write clean, performant SQL, and are proficient in Python
Are curious, strategic, and outcome-oriented: You proactively shape the right questions, translate complex data into clear, actionable insights, and balance speed with depth to drive high-impact decisions
Communicate complex ideas with clarity: You distill deep analysis into crisp, actionable takeaways, and you earn trust across cross-functional teams
Are motivated by impact and mission: You believe in the power of food as medicine to transform healthcare and are excited to improve lives at scale by contributing to Nourish's mission

jobs.description:
Job Summary

NORC at the University of Chicago is seeking a qualified Senior Data Scientist II to join the Statistics and Data Science Department to provide day-to-day program management, technical, and data governance expertise to a large-scale federal data access and record linkage program supporting NIH-funded researchers. This role provides leadership, coordination, and oversight for the delivery of secure data linkage services involving CMS and other federal datasets within a multi-contractor, multi-cloud environment. The role involves partnering closely with technical staff, federal sponsors, external platform providers, and collaborating contractors to monitor progress against project milestones, resolve challenges, and ensure successful execution of data linkage activities, secure data provisioning, regulatory compliance, project reporting, and stakeholder engagement.

This position combines program leadership with substantive expertise in CMS data, record linkage methodologies, federal data governance, and data security. The successful candidate will coordinate activities across multiple functional teams responsible for data linkage, cloud platform operations, data use agreements, training and community engagement, output disclosure review, and data stewardship. The person in this role will serve as a key point of contact for government stakeholders and help ensure that project milestones, quality standards, security requirements, and client expectations are consistently met.

The Senior Data Scientist II hired into this role will also have opportunities to work on other projects and leverage their expertise in other key domains, such as data integration, AI/ML, scientific computing, survey statistics, business development, and collaborative research. Generally, this position supports the development of the strategy and vision for large data analysis projects and may involve managing both the activities and the work product of data analysts and/or data scientists.

Location
: Hybrid role based in either our Chicago Loop or Washington, DC office, with a minimum of six days per month in the office. Highly qualified remote candidates will be considered.

Qualified applicants must be eligible to work in the U.S. We regret that we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this position.

DEPARTMENT: Statistics and Data Science (SDS)

The Statistics and Data Science (SDS) department provides the scientific foundation required to advance NORC’s project portfolio. SDS delivers rigorous, innovative, and fit-for-purpose solutions along the project lifecycle. The department provides leadership for NORC’s approach on a broad range of approaches for study design and the analysis of primary and secondary data. SDS expertise includes artificial intelligence and machine learning; data integration; disclosure avoidance; imputation; data linkage and statistical matching for combining multiple data sources; data quality assessment; efficient and reproducible workflow development; privacy-preserving methods; record linkage; small area estimation; statistical methods for survey sampling, weighting, estimation, and inference; and visualization.

The SDS department works closely with teams in NORC’s Health and Social, Economic, and Global Research divisions, Digital Services and Solutions group, and operational teams across NORC to ensure that statistical excellence and innovation remain central to the organization’s work. Many of NORC’s projects and proposals are led by substantive research departments that require significant contributions from SDS staff. SDS works closely with highly collaborative groups across the organization to ensure success through cross-departmental partnerships. To further capture the innovative spirit of NORC, SDS also leads projects that target departmental focus areas. Examples of recent project topics involving SDS staff include survey sampling redesign; AI for enhancing data quality, standardization, and integration; enhancing traffic safety data; linkage of healthcare data including claims and other administrative data and surveys; and testing data visualization approaches for effective communication.

SDS is composed of a geographically distributed team of over 60 professionals located across NORC offices and remote locations throughout the United States and who are engaged in an array of activities, including research and statistical operations for client projects across NORC’s portfolio, strategic research projects on emerging topics, and business development.

Responsibilities

Lead day-to-day management of a key component of a secure health data access and management program. Oversee project planning, staffing, schedules, deliverables, budgets, and performance to ensure successful contract execution.
Serve as a primary liaison with client, external partners and providers. Manage cross-contractor dependencies, risks, issues, and decision points, proactively identifying barriers to milestone completion and coordinating resolution across technical, operational, and governance team.
Provide technical and programmatic oversight of the data and technology environments supporting the program, including secure cloud platforms, data systems, applications, access controls, and associated operational workflows.
Coordinate delivery of record linkage services, linked data products, and researcher support activities across multiple contractors and stakeholder groups.
Ensure compliance with federal requirements and standards related to data security, privacy, governance, and management of sensitive federal datasets.
Support establishment and maintenance of standard operating procedures, process documentation, and program reporting.
Apply knowledge of CMS data, data linkage methodologies, and federal data management practices to support program objectives.
Prepare and deliver presentations, status briefings, and written communications for federal sponsors and senior organizational leadership.
Recommend methodology for data management, merging, cleaning, transforming and harmonizing data.
Contributing to and reviewing code, datafiles, reports, presentations, and other deliverables.
Engage in business development activities including authoring various sections of the technical proposal.
Train and supervise staff on specific protocols and tasks.
Perform other duties as assigned.

Required Skills

Bachelor’s degree or higher in bioinformatics, information systems, computer science, statistics, data science, health services research, economics, public health, or a related field.
At least 9 years of experience (at least 12 years of experience if Bachelor's degree) in positions of increasing responsibility, working with large datasets and conducting statistical modeling and analytic programming.
Leadership experience adhering to service level agreements and tight deadlines on technically challenging tasks in fast moving projects in consulting, government contracting or a similar setting.
Experience managing teams of statisticians, data scientists, and deep subject matter experts.
Experience managing advanced technical work in cloud-based environments require extensive engagement and coordination with platform contractors and CSPs.
Experience in client communications and relationship management.
Demonstrated experience with managing or implementing data governance processes. Experience with data use agreements and data protection protocols such as statistical disclosure review preferred.
Proficiency with SAS, SQL, R, and/or Python, and experience working in modern cloud, data warehouse or data lake environments.
Working knowledge of the methodologies and technologies for integrating data, including probabilistic record linkage and privacy preserving record linkage.
Demonstrated experience working with Medicare and/or Medicaid administrative or claims data [SA3] . Preferred: Experience supporting large-scale federal research data access programs, secure research environments, or programs involving controlled access to sensitive health or administrative data.
Strong communication skills, including verbal and written communication.
Occasional travel to sites and business meetings.

Qualified applicants must be eligible to work in the U.S. We regret that we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this position.

Salary And Benefits

The pay range for this position is $160,000 - $185,000.

Benefits

This position is classified as regular. Regular staff are eligible for NORC’s comprehensive benefits program. Benefits include, but are not limited to:

Generously subsidized health insurance, effective on the first day of employment
Dental and vision insurance
A defined contribution retirement program, along with a separate voluntary 403(b) retirement program
Group life insurance, long-term and short-term disability insurance
Benefits that promote work/life balance, including generous paid time off, holidays; paid parental leave, bereavement leave, tuition assistance, and an Employee Assistance Program (EAP).

NORC is committed to equity and transparency in its pay practices. We publish salary ranges and benefit information for every job. The listed hiring range reflects what we, in good faith, expect to pay at the time of posting, though actual compensation may vary and may be adjusted over time. A candidate’s placement within the range depends on factors such as competencies, education, qualifications, experience, skills, performance, and organizational needs. This role is bonus eligible. Bonus payment is contingent upon program terms and individual performance.

What We Do

NORC at the University of Chicago is an objective, non-partisan research institution that delivers reliable data and rigorous analysis to guide critical programmatic, business, and policy decisions. Since 1941, our teams have conducted groundbreaking studies, created and applied innovative methods and tools, and advanced principles of scientific integrity and collaboration. Today, government, corporate, and nonprofit clients around the world partner with us to transform increasingly complex information into useful knowledge.

Who We Are

For over 80 years, NORC has evolved in many ways, moving the needle with research methods, technical applications and groundbreaking research findings. But our tradition of excellence, passion for innovation, and commitment to collegiality have remained constant components of who we are as a brand, and who each of us is as a member of the NORC team. With world-class benefits, a business casual environment, and an emphasis on continuous learning, NORC is a place where people join for the stellar research and analysis work for which we’re known, and stay for the relationships they form with their colleagues who take pride in the impact their work is making on a global scale.

About The Role

At Commure, the AI Integration Team plays a crucial role in supporting the company’s core products, Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) and Ambient, by ensuring seamless data flow between our platform and over 40 Electronic Medical Records (EMRs). This team is responsible for fetching vital Encounter and Appointment data from multiple EMRs and, when necessary, writing data back to these systems. The team's work ensures the interoperability and smooth exchange of healthcare data via HL7, enabling healthcare providers to deliver more efficient and accurate care while streamlining administrative processes. We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer who takes ownership end-to-end, moves fast, and wants their work to directly impact how care is delivered.

What You'll Do

Design and implement complex integration solutions between our platform and third-party healthcare systems (EHRs, insurance providers, etc.) while ensuring high performance, reliability, and scalability.
Utilize the latest developments in LLM technology to automate the reverse-engineering of electronic health records.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams (product, engineering, and healthcare) to gather integration requirements, define technical approaches, and prioritize tasks based on business needs.
Contribute to the technical direction of the integration platform by proposing and implementing improvements to architecture, tools, and technologies.
Take ownership of end-to-end integration workflows, from design and development through to deployment and post-launch monitoring.
Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, troubleshoot integration issues, and proactively improve the reliability of integrations in production environments.
Ensure all integration work adheres to healthcare compliance and security standards (e.g., HIPAA, HL7, FHIR) and collaborate with security teams to protect sensitive data.
Work closely with junior engineers to provide technical guidance and mentorship, helping them solve problems and ensuring high-quality code standards are followed.
Drive the implementation of best practices for integration development, including testing, error handling, version control, and continuous integration.
Collaborate with DevOps and QA teams to implement monitoring and alerting systems that ensure integration reliability and system health in production.
Stay up-to-date with industry trends in healthcare technology, integration patterns, and emerging tools, continuously suggesting and applying innovations that can improve system performance and integration capabilities.
Participate in agile development cycles, contributing to sprint planning, retrospectives, and maintaining a collaborative and efficient working environment

What You Have

[Required] Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent extensive experience
5+ years of professional software development industry experience
Proficiency in backend languages like Python, Go, or C++.
Proficiency in frontend languages like Javascript, HTML, CSS
Experience including but not limited to Git, GCP / AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, relational and non-relational DBs, and monitoring/alerting tools
Proven track record of designing and implementing end-to-end solutions and making successful architectural decisions
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
